text:
Hi everyone,

My wife is an English speaker, and we’re expecting our first baby at the end of August.

We’re looking for the wisdom of the crowd on two topics:

**1. English-language birth preparation course**
We’re planning for a natural birth, and we’d love recommendations for a course in English that you felt genuinely prepared you and your partner.

**2. Medical circumcision (Brit Milah)**
We’re looking for recommendations for a medically trained professional (doctor/mohel) who performs circumcisions.

Thanks so much in advance—we really appreciate any recommendations or experiences you can share!

Thanks!
